model.name: audio_cnn
model.checkpoint_provenance: Vendored from upstream GitHub repo Devil-92/Fake-Audio-Detector (src/audio_detection/model.py architecture, models/deepfake_cnn.pth checkpoint), recovered from a prior local review clone and integrated into VoiceGuard's checkpoints/ directory.

dataset.primary_variant: for-norm/for-norm/testing (matches upstream repo's own training/eval preprocessing recipe: pad/trim to 4s @ 16kHz)
dataset.secondary_variant_appendix: for-2sec/for-2seconds/testing (pre-clipped 2-second variant; kept only as a secondary robustness data point, NOT used for the primary upstream-comparison verdict)
dataset.sampling_method: random.sample(seed=42) of 50 real + 50 fake from 80 candidate files per class per variant, collected via paginated Kaggle dataset file listing
dataset.class_balance: 50 bonafide / 50 spoof (perfectly balanced) in both variants

inference_path.description: Real production HTTP API only, no direct model calls, no mocked inference.
steps: POST /api/v1/scans/{id}/process (triggers real AI pipeline background job)
GET /api/v1/scans/{id}/technical (real inference result: verdict, confidence, raw_bonafide_score, raw_spoof_score, inference_time_ms)
inference_path.note: 4 accounts used only to stay under the app's own per-user scan-creation rate limit (30/hour); this is normal multi-tenant usage, not a bypass of any control.

hardware.host_os: Microsoft Windows 11 Home Single Language, 10.0.26200 Build 26200
hardware.gpu: None used — CPU-only inference (torch cpu build, MODEL_DEVICE=auto resolved to cpu)

software.deployment: docker compose (postgres:16-alpine, redis:7-alpine, backend api/Dockerfile + manually installed ML deps, frontend vite dev server)
